name: sol-luna-team
description: Hybrid cost-aware Codex team with Terra parent orchestration, worktree-safe setup, protected task baselines, single-writer locks, ignored-file write guards, bounded Luna workers, and separate Sol decision/review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Terra leads; guarded writers execute; Sol handles unresolved decisions and material-risk review.
interface.longDescription: Use Terra High as the parent, Luna High/Max for bounded execution, Terra High for already-decided complex work, and Sol High only for unresolved material decisions or final material-risk review. Versioned agents, worktree-safe setup/status, writer locks, protected baselines, ignored-file write-set checks, routing policy, and CI evals reduce orchestration drift and accidental scope expansion.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-luna-team to implement this change with SLT v0.4.0 guarded routing.
Use $sol-luna-team to debug this issue while reserving Sol for unresolved decisions or material final-review risk.
Use $sol-luna-team and enforce writer lock, protected baseline, and write-set verification for every delegated writer.
